sample: 100 CC BY 2.0 images in Karpathy test, disjoint from author train/val; see data/manifest.json

attention.rule: first 4 selected IDs, teacher-force generated beam3 caption, final decoder layer cross-attention mean over all 12 heads
attention.alignment: row j-1 predicts token sequence[j], with decoder input sequence[:-1]; retain CLS weight separately and renormalize patch weights only for display
attention.causality: diagnostic association, not causal attribution, segmentation or proof of grounding

translation.input: beam3 English caption only; translator sees no image

evaluation: 5 English references per image; PTB tokenizer; corpus BLEU-4 and CIDEr on these 100 images, IDF on 100 references; no Korean reference scores; no test tuning
